definitions.explanation: a person of outstanding talent or intellect

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧はまれ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧{俊才|しゅんさい}だ。
{若|わか}き{俊才|しゅんさい}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}→研究所：19075_kenkyuujo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{俊才|しゅんさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めて→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦{最先端|さいせんたん}→最先端：13011_saisentan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: This research institute gathers talented people from around the world to conduct cutting-edge research.

notes:
A literary, somewhat formal word for a person of exceptional talent or intellect. Often used in written language and formal contexts to praise someone's abilities. The character {俊|しゅん} means "excellence" or "genius."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {若|わか}き{俊才|しゅんさい}: young talent/prodigy
- まれ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧{俊才|しゅんさい}: a rare genius
- {俊才|しゅんさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to gather talented people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧: genius — more commonly used and stronger in nuance, implying innate extraordinary ability
- ⟦{秀才|しゅうさい}→秀才：18297_shuusai⟧: brilliant person — emphasizes academic excellence and diligence rather than raw talent
- {英才|えいさい}: gifted person — often used in the compound ⟦{英才|えいさい}{教育|きょういく}→英才教育：18469_eisaikyouiku⟧ (gifted education)
- {逸材|いつざい}: exceptional talent — emphasizes rarity and outstanding quality
